title: Version-aware SDD context for coding agents
requirements: Only the latest active specification revision may govern a coding task
Superseded and retired decisions must not be injected as current rules
Return traceable current code and tests with SHA-256 and line excerpts
Invalidate earlier verification when any declared source/test bytes or the specification content changes
A test may become valid again only after executing a successful check against the current inputs
Enforce path safety and an explicit output byte budget
decisions: Use repository-local JSON specifications instead of silently extracting policy from chat history
Run tests only on explicit user/agent command, using argv without a shell
Keep SDD source evidence independent of PowerContext Memory and Handoff persistence
